verbatim: **效应尺度**：暴露侧汇总统计以 BMI 的效应量单位表示，而 BMI 类 GWAS 通常以标准差为单位报告遗传效应。本报告按这一惯例解读合并估计——这是解读假设，运行输出并没有逐字声明单位。OR = 1.53 因此应读作「遗传预测的 BMI 每升高 1 个标准差，CAD 的比值比为 1.53」，而不是「每 1 kg/m²」。
whyItIsWrong: Report concedes the exposure effect unit is unconfirmed yet uses per-SD in estimates and conclusions.
note: Preserve numerical effect in source units until a source field confirms the scale; test SD, kg/m2, inverse-normalized and unknown units. Keep the supported artifacts and calculations; correct or qualify the affected statement only. No human approval is required.
